edges.body_source: This is a placeholder; no evidence has been reviewed.

Agreement SV-408, signed 1 April 2028, covers 12 completed service visits for the municipal north depot. At the stated original rate of $120.00 per visit, the provisional amount is $1,440. The evidence does not establish whether the rate was amended or whether finance authorized payment.

Agreement SV-408, signed 1 April 2028, covers 12 completed service visits for the municipal north depot. Under signed amendment AM-408, effective 1 April 2028, the rate is $95.00 per visit, making the provisional amount $1,140. The evidence does not establish whether finance authorized payment.

Agreement SV-408, signed 1 April 2028, covers service visits for the municipal north depot. Under signed amendment AM-408, effective 1 April 2028, the rate is $95.00 per visit. The depot supervisor accepted 11 of the 12 visits; visit 12 was cancelled and is not billable. The 11 accepted visits are covered by AM-408, for a payable amount of $1,045. The evidence does not establish whether finance authorized payment or whether appropriation is recorded.

Agreement SV-408, signed 1 April 2028, covers service visits for the municipal north depot. Under signed amendment AM-408, effective 1 April 2028, the rate is $95.00 per visit. The depot supervisor accepted 11 of the 12 visits; visit 12 was cancelled and is not billable. The 11 accepted visits are covered by AM-408, for a payable amount of $1,045. Finance authorization FA-408 was signed 19 April 2028 for payment of accepted SV-408 work. The $1,500.00 appropriation is available and has not been exhausted. The signed authorization and available appropriation satisfy the release condition; release payment of $1,045.
